questions.question: Give three examples of relay applications in automobiles.
questions.solution_html:
• Give three examples of relay applications in automobiles.
  • Explanation on relays, (2marks)
  • Any 3 examples of relays, (1mark) each
  • Headlight Control: Relays switch high -current headlights using a low -current
  • dashboard switch.
  • Starter Motor Activation: Relays safely control the high current needed by the
  • starter motor from the ignition switch.
  • Horn Operation: Relays allow th e horn to receive sufficient current while
  • protecting the horn button and wiring.
  • Cooling Fan Control: Relays turn on/off radiator or engine cooling fans based on
  • temperature sensor signals.
  • Fuel Pump Control: Relays supply power to the fuel pump only when the ignition
  • is on, ensuring safe operation.
